info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Dealer Desk Management API
info.description: The Dealer Desk Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently adjust and update dealer desk configurations within their wholesale trading systems. Key operations include modifying dealer-related parameters to streamline trading processes and enhance operational efficiency. Common consumers of this API are trading desks and systems administrators who require real-time adjustments to trading settings. This API facilitates better management of dealer activities and ensures compliance with internal policies and market regulations.
